name: Shandong Oriental Ocean Sci-Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: Shandong Oriental Ocean Sci-Tech Co., Ltd., established in Yantai, China in 2001, operates through its subsidiaries across diverse sectors, including marine aquaculture, food processing, real estate development, and the hotel and tourism industries. In its marine aquaculture segment, the company specializes in breeding and cultivating various marine species such as sea cucumbers, shellfishes, kelp seedlings, and other valuable aquatic products, alongside general fish cultivation and species improvement initiatives. The food processing division handles the trade, logistics, refrigeration, and processing of aquatic products, also managing bonded warehouses for these goods. Additionally, the company provides property management services. Its business footprint spans both domestic Chinese markets and international territories.
